mentions.name: TUI Sampler
mentions.description: A terminal (TUI) music sampler for beatmaking that cherry-picks favorite features from modern and vintage hardware samplers, DAWs, plugins, outboard FX gear, and DJ equipment — including MPC-style workflows, SP-404/SP-1200 flavor, S950 filters, BOSS RC-202-style looping, Alesis 3630-style compression, Serato Sample features, and stem separation. It locates and organizes samples and lets users make beats entirely without a mouse, aiming for a hardware feel with software power. Live and free to use on macOS and Linux (Windows coming soon), launching as v1.0 with Factory Kits for newcomers.
mentions.problem: The author scratched his own itch for locating and organizing samples, and wanted a tactile, immediate way to make beats without a mouse.
mentions.audience: folks in the beatmaking community, including users new to beatmaking
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a TUI sampler which cherry-picks my favourite features from modern & vintage hardware samplers, DAWs, plugins, outboard FX gear, and DJ equipment.
